title: OSQ Rack-Mounted Edge Computer Server
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND.FA4625  509 CONS CC
description_text: This is an official Request for Quote (RFQ) Notice FA462526Q1073. The U.S. Air Force 509th Contracting Squadron at Whiteman AFB is posting this solicitation, Request for Quote (RFQ), for the purchase and delivery of a rack-mounted edge computer server in accordance with the attached Salient Characteristics dated 18 March 2026. RESPONSES: Quotes are due via email to the contract administrator Mr. Justin McCoy at justin.mccoy.4@us.af.mil, AND the contracting officer Ms. Lynn Duchene at lynnann.duchene@us.af.mil by 3:00pm CST on Wednesday 20 May 2026. Responses must include the RFQ number (FA462526Q1073) and title (OSQ Rack-Mounted Edge Computer Server) in the subject line of the email submission.
